terra.problem: The text says the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, not that the gate belongs to him.
Saying every sheep gets a name adds that the sheep are given names. The text says the shepherd calls his own sheep by name.
The text does not say the sheep knew the thieves’ voices. Jesus says they did not listen to them.
The claim that the gate is not for a select few goes beyond Jesus’ statement that anyone who enters through Him will be saved.
The burnt-batch comparison is unclear and does not match the hired hand running from a wolf.
The verse says Jesus lays down His life to take it up again. It does not state the conclusion that He is not leaving the flock forever.
The speakers do not identify the man born blind in this verse. The connection to his story is asserted without a reference to that passage.
